**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no non-solicitation, non-poaching, or no-hire covenant. I reviewed all 75 paragraphs (the document is a single section) and ran a text search for solicitation language, which returned nothing. The General Provisions (p0063–p0073) address governing law, publicity, independent contractor status, notices, severability/survival, force majeure, and assignment — no restrictive covenants — and the survival list in p0070 likewise contains none.

Because nothing restricts our ability to hire or approach Vendor personnel, this sits at the playbook's **preferred** position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), not the fallback, so no edit is appropriate.

One point to carry forward for negotiation: if the Vendor proposes adding a non-solicit on redraft, we should accept no more than the fallback — mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no no-hire.
